title: Pointwise codimension-one ramification criterion for a flat quasi-finite morphism
statement: Let $X,Y$ be locally Noetherian schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be locally of finite type and flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], and quasi-finite at $x\in X$ [pqf-def-quasifinite]. Suppose $0<\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}$ [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. For each $x′$ specializing to $x$ with $\dim\mathcal O_{X,x′}=1$, assume an open neighbourhood $V$ of $x′$ on which $V\to Y$ is formally unramified [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism]. Then there exists an open neighbourhood of $x$ on which $f$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism].

proof.text: Apply exists_etale_finite_open_of_isolated_fiber_point to the open isolated fibre singleton supplied by hq. Obtain b:T→Y etale, a finite open piece V in the pullback and v mapping to x. Put a=V.ι followed by the first projection and g=V.ι followed by the second. The pullback square gives a followed by f = g followed by b. Composition and base-change instances give Etale a, Flat g and IsFinite g; local finite type of b gives local Noetherianness of T.

Use Scheme.Hom.coheight_apply_of_flat for the etale map a, which is flat and locally quasi-finite, and Mathlib ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_coheight to identify dimensions of V stalks with X stalks. Specializations map along a. Given z specializing to v with dimension-one stalk, pull the supplied formally unramified open W of a(z) back along a. The restriction of the etale a is formally unramified; compose with W.ι followed by f, rewrite the pullback commutativity identity, and use FormallyUnramified.of_comp to cancel b. This supplies a formally unramified open of z for g. Positive dimension at v follows from a(v)=x and the same dimension identity.

Apply exists_etale_neighbourhood_of_finite_flat_of_codimension_one to g and v, with the positive-dimension and dimension-one unramifiedness hypotheses just proved. It gives B open in V containing v with B.ι followed by g etale. The discriminant and dimension-one branch-locus argument remains entirely in this existing finite-specialization node.

Put e=B.ι followed by a. It is etale and its composite with f is etale by the commutative square and composition with b. Its image U is open and contains x. Use IsOpenImmersion.lift to factor e through U.ι as q:B→U. Etale.of_comp proves q etale. Its surjectivity follows from the definition of U as range e and injectivity of U.ι. Smooth.of_comp_of_flat_of_surjective applied to q then proves Smooth (U.ι followed by f).

In the original fibre the singleton of f.asFiber x is open. It is a discrete singleton, so its topological dimension is zero. The infimum over neighbourhoods defining topologicalKrullDimAt is at most zero using this singleton. Each neighbourhood contains the point, so the closure of that singleton is a nonempty irreducible closed subset, giving the lower bound zero. Apply exists_etale_open_of_smooth_of_fibre_dimension_zero to f, x and U and return the smaller etale open.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_etale_neighbourhood_of_flat_of_quasiFiniteAt_of_codimension_one
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat f] (x : X)
    (hq : f.QuasiFiniteAt x)
    (hpos : (0 : WithBot ℕ∞) < ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hunram : ∀ x' : X, Specializes x' x →
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x') = 1 →
      ∃ V : X.Opens, x' ∈ V ∧ FormallyUnramified (V.ι ≫ f)) :
    ∃ V : X.Opens, x ∈ V ∧ Etale (V.ι ≫ f)
